correctness.rationale: For finite simple \(C_{2r}^{\square d}\) with r>=3, vertex-transitivity gives a single colour beyond the visible root radius; independent coordinate reflections and permutations keep histogram fibres monochromatic. The weighted predecessor multiset has weights 1 away from the even antipode and 2 at the antipode, with aggregate triangular identities \(B_r=(N-2)m_r\) and \(B_j=(N-1)m_j+w_{j+1}m_{j+1}\). For \(N\ge3\) these invert; \(N=1\) is unique at fixed distance; for \(N=2\) the one-antipode case cannot match two positive nonantipodal coordinates for r>=3 because the latter have a predecessor with two positive coordinates. This gives injective shell-by-shell recovery through rd-1. The unique furthest histogram then makes the partition stable, and shells rd-1 and rd prove sharpness. \(C_4^{\square d}=Q_{2d}\), where distance regularity instead gives truncated distance classes. Binomial partition counts and orbit sizes are derived explicitly. Finite checks independently passed 21 direct graphs, 43 quotient cases and 58 predecessor tests, without being substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: Actual searches of published-finding corpus and published literature were compared at the level of the theorem and implications. Existing general refinement/iteration papers and previously recorded marked toroidal-grid, odd-cycle-power and hypercube results do not assert the all-round even-cycle-power formula for arbitrary d; the \(d=2\) stable orbit portion is acknowledged as already covered. value.rationale: The graph family is a canonical discrete torus family and its refinement trajectory is a substantive invariant tied to logical quantifier depth and orbit determination. Beyond the known final \(d=2\) toroidal orbit count and prior odd cycles, the proof gives all rounds and all dimensions and exhibits a sharp exceptional four-cycle phase where Cartesian-factor profiles irretrievably collapse to Hamming distance. The weighted predecessor injection is the necessary new structural mechanism; the result is a natural completion with a genuine boundary phenomenon rather than an arbitrary finite slice or a trivial parameter increment.
